question_catalog.COMMON-01: 确认评审对象是合同 flai.production-snapshot-assembler.read.v1 的冻结 SHA-256；本决定只评审只读设计合同，不声明 production-ready，不授权实现，也不授权生产 Schema、API 或状态机变更。
question_catalog.module_ownership: Assembler 是否只属于 Control Kernel，且没有吸收 Identity、Authorization、ExecutionBroker、Knowledge 或 Observer 的裁决权？
question_catalog.public_seam: 唯一公开调用面、内部 WitnessResolver seam 和依赖方向是否明确并保持深 Module？
question_catalog.no_second_state_machine: 合同是否保证只读、无业务写入，且不创建第二任务状态机或第二控制面？
question_catalog.authenticated_opaque_context: 认证上下文是否只能由受信通道铸造，且调用方无法伪造 actor、role、ACL 或 reality？
question_catalog.acl_classification_existence: 对象存在性、ACL、clearance、classification 与字段投影是否在释放前 fail-closed？
question_catalog.release_fence: actor/session、credential epoch、ResourceEnvelope、AuthorizationDecision 与 verification-policy 的二次 fence 是否覆盖撤权和竞态？
question_catalog.single_read_transaction: 业务事实是否在一个 SQLite read transaction 中冻结，且外部验签和 release fence 不会混入新旧事实？
question_catalog.tail_window: event tail window、总数、current event 与重复/冲突检查是否确定且不静默截断？
question_catalog.query_only: 连接、仓储与失败路径是否保证 read-only/query-only，无隐式迁移或写副作用？
question_catalog.performance_bounds: 读取规模、超时、锁占用和大对象策略是否有可实施的硬边界，未知时是否拒绝而非退化放行？
question_catalog.strict_receipt_schema: receipt、admission core/seal、签名输入与 digest 绑定是否严格、无歧义且支持 invalid-first 验证？
question_catalog.issuer_authority: issuer kind、key usage、工作负载身份与 Broker/Sandbox 独立作证是否由 Trust Policy 精确授权？
question_catalog.algorithm_policy: 算法、canonicalization、签名编码、时间与重放规则是否避免降级、混淆和摘要回环？
question_catalog.key_rotation_revocation: 历史签发策略与当前验证策略、轮换、吊销、retrospective compromise 和 release-time policy fence 是否闭合？
question_catalog.composite_backend_identity: backend 是否表示 ExecutionBroker 组合身份，而不会把 AgentRuntime、SandboxProvider 或 Tool Adapter 任一方冒充整体？
question_catalog.broker_sandbox_independence: Broker receipt 与 Sandbox witness 是否在 workload、leaf key material、key usage 和绑定对象上独立？
question_catalog.phase_witness_binding: REAL/MOCK/TEST 及各阶段是否只能由对应受信证据产生，不能从 status 或日志自报推导？
question_catalog.four_key_provenance: Observer 投影是否只携带 scope_id、chunk_id、source、fingerprint，并保持可追溯且不泄漏正文或未授权元数据？
question_catalog.authority_unresolved_boundary: 只有检索 provenance、缺少 KnowledgeVersion 权威、有效或适用证明时，是否保持 unresolved 而不伪装成权威依据？
question_catalog.adapter_v3_compatibility: FactSet 与 readSnapshot 是否和冻结的 Stage C Runtime Observer Adapter v3 一致且没有隐式 UI 数据源？
question_catalog.diagnostic_only: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY 是否只支持受限诊断体验，不显示为 REAL、completed 绿色、交付成功或人签？
question_catalog.failure_experience: 稳定失败码、隐藏存在性、证据缺失、部分可见与重试语义是否支持诚实、低焦虑且不泄密的界面？

implementation_authorization.note: This review package cannot grant implementation authority.

external_trust_verifier.note: The local checker cannot authenticate these references. A future pinned organization-approved verifier must resolve identity, role, signature/audit, revocation, findings, SoD exceptions, and append-only decision history before the named review gate can pass.

reviews.responsibility_scope: ProductionSnapshotAssembler Module ownership, public seam, dependency direction, read-only boundary, and prohibition of a second state machine or control plane.
Trusted authenticated context, object authorization, ACL/classification/existence handling, and release-time authorization fences.
SQLite point-in-time read boundary, event tail window, query-only behavior, locking, limits, and performance bounds.
Strict receipt schemas, issuer authorization, signature and digest rules, algorithm policy, key lifecycle, revocation, and verification-policy fences.
Composite backend identity, Broker and Sandbox witness independence, execution binding, and phase-specific REAL/MOCK/TEST evidence.
Knowledge four-key provenance projection, authorization-preserving evidence handling, and the unresolved authority/applicability boundary.
Stage C Runtime Observer Adapter v3 compatibility, diagnostic-only projection, failure semantics, and honest user experience.
